data.name: Tribulum
data.detailed_description:
Faith will be tested. Survival is only the beginning.

The world has collapsed after a series of inexplicable events. Ordinary people are no longer the same. Their bodies remain alive, but a demonic plague has destroyed their moral conscience, transforming humanity into violent and unpredictable creatures.

In Tribulum, you play as a survivor trapped in a world consumed by fear, persecution, and supernatural forces inspired by the events of the Great Tribulation.

Explore abandoned cities, ruined buildings, and devastated environments as you scavenge for resources, uncover the truth behind humanity's collapse, and fight to stay alive.

Key Features

  • Intense third-person combat with firearms and melee weapons.

  • Brutal Finisher system to eliminate weakened enemies.

  • Survival mechanics featuring limited ammunition and resource management.

  • Exploration of immersive environments filled with secrets, documents, and environmental storytelling.

  • Stealth gameplay that allows you to avoid unnecessary confrontations.

  • Enemies possessed by a demonic plague, each displaying aggressive and unpredictable behavior.

  • Progress through a narrative-driven campaign focused on horror, action, and survival.

Every location holds clues to what happened.

Every enemy bears the remnants of the humanity they have lost.

Every decision could mean the difference between survival... or becoming part of the darkness.

With an oppressive atmosphere, brutal combat, exploration, resource management, and a narrative inspired by biblical themes presented in a fictional setting, Tribulum delivers a gripping action-horror survival experience where every encounter could be your last.

Survive the Great Tribulation.

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of violence, blood, gore, and disturbing horror imagery. Players engage in combat against possessed and infected enemies using firearms and melee weapons. The game includes graphic finishing animations and themes involving demonic possession and the end of the world. There is no sexual content.
